name: You and Not You
source:
It's time you get to know YANY: who you are and who you aren't. Take a short journey through your self and discover what kind of entity you might be.

[from [url=https://wonderbreath.itch.io/you-and-not-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
是时候了解YANY了：你是谁，你不是谁。进行一次短暂的自我之旅，发现你可能是什么样的实体。

[来自[url=https://wonderbreath.itch.io/you-and-not-you]itch.io[/url]]
